_doc: Gap closures of the canvas family (p15-oracle-083), applied to scripts/cmux-next/every-action-gaps.json by p15-oracle-087. Every id needed the canvasLayout context. The fixture (scripts/cmux-next/oracle/action_fixtures/canvas.py) carves A | (B / (C | D)) out of the base pane, D focused, then runs toggleCanvasLayout. The canvas also holds the session's other panes on that screen (the light base's right-hand sibling, more on STRESS), so each closed id names a property of A..D that makes it change something whatever panes surround them; its sample runs a handler and is not refused. canvas_test.py's ArrangeMovesTests checks the arrange claims with the light base's sibling and with a STRESS-like extra column. canvasRevealFocusedPane needs the same context but stays in `excluded` (the SKIPS pattern `reveal`), not here.

closed.canvasAlignBottom: B's bottom edge is above A's, so B moves down to the canvas's lowest bottom edge
closed.canvasAlignLeft: B, C and D sit right of A's left edge, so they move to the canvas's leftmost edge
closed.canvasAlignRight: A's and C's right edges are left of B's, so A and C move to the canvas's rightmost edge
closed.canvasAlignTop: C and D sit below A's and B's top edge, so they move up to the canvas's topmost edge
closed.canvasDistributeHorizontally: B and C share a left edge, so the later of them in left-edge order packs right of the earlier at the 16 pt canvas gap
closed.canvasDistributeVertically: A and B share a top edge, so the later of them in top-edge order packs below the earlier at the 16 pt canvas gap
closed.canvasEqualizeHeights: A is taller than D, the focused pane, so A takes D's height
closed.canvasEqualizeWidths: A and B are wider than D, the focused pane, so they take D's width
closed.canvasOverview: fits every pane of the canvas (A..D and the session's other panes) in the viewport; a second run returns to the camera before it
closed.canvasTidy: B's center is above A's, so B and A go in different rows and tidy moves a pane (checked with the panes around A..D)
closed.canvasZoomIn: zoom 1 to 1.25 about the viewport center
closed.canvasZoomOut: zoom 1 to 0.8 about the viewport center
closed.canvasZoomReset: PREPARE runs canvasZoomIn first: a fresh canvas is at zoom 1, where Actual Size refuses
